India's Russian oil imports reach record high in June

India's crude oil imports from Russia reached a record high in June, driven by attractive pricing and disruptions in traditional Middle Eastern supply routes. This surge in imports has helped India's overall crude imports rebound to near pre-conflict levels. The situation highlights India's strategy of diversifying its energy sources amidst global geopolitical and supply chain challenges.
